text:
You hear two nurses discussing their work attire.
What do they agree about?
A uniform provides a more professional appearance.
Scrubs provide a higher standard of hygiene.

You hear a podiatrist giving advice to a patient about her Achilles tendonitis.
The podiatrist instructs the patient to avoid running
for extended periods of time.
barefoot on hard surfaces.

You hear a radiographer briefing a patient about the importance of remaining still during a procedure.
What is the patient concerned about?
falling asleep during the procedure
a sudden numbness of the arm

You hear a ward manager reminding a group of nursing assistants of their role and responsibility.
The manager explains that
they must document any change in patient conduct or condition.
their patient care must be assigned by a senior member of staff.


You hear a registered nurse providing a handover of a patient’s progress.
What does her colleague need to do?
Confirm with the doctor before giving the patient his medication.
Contact the appropriate staff member who will transfer the patient.

You hear a consultant discussing the history of a patient’s injured shoulder.
What does the consultant think is the most likely cause of the injury?
insufficient preparation before playing sport
an overuse of the joint during an activity
